elbow_scale.domain_note: Captured side-specific domains, including the neutral bind anchor. Clamp target scale only; never clamp main-bone rotation.
elbow_scale.constant_scale_policy: Original body unit Y/Z baseline, preserve helper X. Do not rebase from current reference Y/Z: it can already contain experimental scaling. Custom helper Y/Z modifications are not supported.

provenance.geometry: Meddle reference exports; skinning checked independently against Blender 4.5.3
provenance.body_policy: Visible top/dwn proxy surface includes smallclothes; face uses skin meshes only. The bust-0 candidate excludes animation-driven shoulder/elbow scales.
provenance.rotation_rules: Shoulder, elbow and wrist rotation rules remain unchanged. Experimental knee helper curve only for j_asi_b_l/r; scale Y/Z only for n_hhiji_l/r.

knee_rotation.note: Coefficients were frozen before independent validation. Deeper angles have single-action/cross-side/phase validation only. Limits apply to the helper curve, not main leg rotation.
